Read and follow the E2E requirements in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#end-to-end-validation).
Changes to evaluation behavior need a real `lmms_eval` run, including fixes to
existing models and tasks. Use the existing E2E fields in the PR template for
exact commands, model/data/hardware, results, and evidence. If blocked, document
the attempt and keep the PR in draft; never invent successful validation.
